{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Navy blue sheath dress, knee-length cut, midnight navy color (#0a192f), heavy wool crepe fabric.
Oxbridge textured blazer, tailored fit to the waist, deep charcoal color (#36454F), virgin wool blend fabric.
Tan leather ankle boots with a low block heel, classic Chelsea style, warm cognac color (#c19a6b), smooth calfskin leather fabric.
Silver geometric stud earrings and a simple pearl pendant necklace to add subtle elegance without overwhelming the look.

This outfit works perfectly for a banking interview in autumn as the navy blue sheath dress meets the formal dress code while the matching blazer adds a layer of professional polish suitable for cooler weather. The absence of high heels respects her request for comfort, and the tan boots provide a warm contrast that keeps the ensemble from looking too somber, adhering strictly to her refusal of black. The textured fabrics and silver accessories introduce subtle sophistication, ensuring she appears both competent and approachable for an analyst role at ten in the morning."}
